pages.title: SkyHop — 3D Parkour Adventure
pages.creator: YotamGames
pages.description: Leap across floating islands in SkyHop — 3D Parkour Adventure. Use double jumps and powers such as Super Jump or Shield to clear the traps ahead. Collect coins and stars, activate checkpoints and finish levels to earn upgrades.

pages.title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Clear a packed lot in Bus Escape: Clear Jam so passengers can go home. Work out which vehicles have an open route, then send them away in an order that frees the others. Keep reorganizing until the jam is gone.

pages.title: Block Escape
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Slide blocks off the screen in Block Escape. Each piece travels only in the direction shown by its arrow, so clear the ones with open paths first. Use the gaps they leave to release the rest.

pages.title: Emoji Guess
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Decode a sequence of pictures in Emoji Guess. Work out which phrase, saying or film title the emojis represent, then choose the answer. Read the images together when their individual meanings do not immediately reveal the clue.

pages.title: City Tower Builder
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Construct towers and place the buildings around a growing settlement in City Tower Builder. Line up each floor so it stays balanced instead of falling away. Combine steady stacking with city development as you create more houses.

pages.title: Pool Merge
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Shoot numbered balls into equal values in Pool Merge. Use the billiard rebounds to set up merges and make room on the table. Try Classic mode to manage the ball limit or Arcade mode for a timed challenge.

pages.title: Furry Wedding Proposal
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style a fox and rabbit for their marriage in Furry Wedding Proposal. Choose clothing and accessories for both characters and coordinate the details of their celebration. Give the unusual couple a finished look for the occasion.

pages.title: Mega Shark
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Hunt fish as a shark in Mega Shark. Eat as much as you can during a sixty-second round and use your speed or special strengths to keep feeding. Gather coins and trophies to unlock additional hunting stages.

pages.title: Emoji Sort – Fun Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Zoomie Games
pages.description: Group matching faces in Emoji Sort – Fun Puzzle Game. Move the mixed emojis between tubes and use spare room to separate them by type. Plan the transfers so each container ends with one kind of emoji.

pages.title: Dynamons 12
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Collect creatures across Guardian Tomb and a bonus cave in Dynamons 12. Learn from Captain Jovani, meet the eight titans and train the Dynamons you recruit. Build a team to take into battles as you explore the new areas.

pages.title: Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Search five floors of a dangerous facility in Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1. Gather keys, solve puzzles and decide whether to fight monsters or avoid them. Ration the limited resources and saves as you work through the survival-horror story.

pages.title: Resident Evil: Purge Operation
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Find weapons before the alarm sounds in Resident Evil: Purge Operation. Arm yourself with tools such as a shotgun or sniper rifle and prepare for the undead entering the area. Keep moving so the horde cannot surround you.

pages.title: Doggi
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Explore scenes and solve hidden-object puzzles in Doggi. Search for the requested items and work out how the clues fit the next task. Use a hint when a small detail stops you from progressing.

pages.title: Drive To Survive
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drive through a zombie outbreak in Drive To Survive. Use the car to clear enemies and earn money, then buy stronger vehicles for the locations ahead. Work through each route as the opposition becomes harder to get past.

pages.title: Popping Pets
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Connect adjacent groups of at least three animals in Popping Pets. Remove them to score during a one-minute round and look for bombs that clear a larger area. Keep finding another group before time runs out.

pages.title: Ninja Time
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Grow a bamboo pole to cross gaps in Ninja Time. Judge the distance to the next platform and stop extending when the length looks right. Collect coins along the route to open more ninja skins.

pages.title: Cat Sorter Puzzle
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Move cats between seats in Cat Sorter Puzzle. Gather the same colors into separate stacks, using empty seats to free animals trapped under another color. Plan the rearrangement until the scattered cats are neatly grouped.

pages.title: Funny Blade & Magic
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Reclaim a goblin's legacy in Funny Blade & Magic. Fight with swords, axes or hammers and combine close-range attacks with spells. Use powers such as teleportation or slowed time to create openings against your enemies.

pages.title: Cyber Surfer Skateboard
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Ride a futuristic board through musical courses in Cyber Surfer Skateboard. Steer past obstacles and follow the rhythm as the next section approaches. Keep the rider on the route while you work through the neon-styled challenges.

pages.title: Food Snake
pages.creator: Cryptland
pages.description: Eat to grow in Food Snake while staying clear of obstacles and your own body. Plan turns with the increasing length in mind so you leave a route to the next meal. Advance through levels that make the snake faster.

pages.title: Extreme Parking Challenge
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Park cars through obstacle-filled routes in Extreme Parking Challenge. Maneuver precisely around the barriers and bring the vehicle into its marked space. Earn money from completed challenges to unlock more cars to try.

pages.title: Mahjong Kitchen
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Discover recipes through tile puzzles in Mahjong Kitchen. Match the food-themed pieces and work out the dishes as you spend time in the virtual cafe. Complete more boards to add another recipe to your collection.

pages.title: Draw the Rest
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Finish an incomplete picture in Draw the Rest. Look for the missing outline or object and draw it where it belongs. Use the surrounding details as clues when the intended addition is hard to recognize.

pages.title: Connect Master - Classic Game
pages.creator: AGED STUDIO LIMITED
pages.description: Connect pairs while exploring themed scenes in Connect Master - Classic Game. Find two identical tiles with a route between them and remove them to open the board. Try different visual themes as the matching journey continues.

pages.title: Catch The Impostor
pages.creator: RipoGame
pages.description: Help a guard clear unwanted visitors from a museum in Catch The Impostor. Find and catch every intruder before the time limit ends. Work through the game's stages to keep the guard from losing his job.

pages.title: Pixel Hardcore
pages.creator: GamesComeFirst
pages.description: Find a key and reach the locked door in Pixel Hardcore. Run and jump through the platforms while avoiding obstacles between the two. Open the exit once you have recovered the key to finish the stage.

pages.title: Pac Hero
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear every dot from a maze in Pac Hero. Avoid monsters until a magic potion makes them vulnerable, then use the brief advantage to cross dangerous areas. Finish the map while keeping the hero alive.

pages.title: Ultimate Robo Duel 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Battle with mechanical fighters in Ultimate Robo Duel 3D. Move into range to punch or kick, then pull away when the opposing robot attacks. Fight the computer or challenge a friend using the two-player controls.

pages.title: Long Long Hair
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Collect hair and steer through hazards in Long Long Hair. Move between the sides of the track to protect the growing length. Keep as much hair as possible intact until you reach the finish.

pages.title: Falling Ball 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide a ball through a descending obstacle course in Falling Ball 3D. Use the mouse to keep it clear of barriers as it drops. Reach the end of the level without a collision to continue.

pages.title: Music Garden
pages.creator: WHOW Games GmbH
pages.description: Compose a tune with plants in Music Garden. Drag flowers into the space to introduce their sounds, then arrange the combination you want to hear. Add effects and mix the parts to change how the garden plays.

pages.title: Confront
pages.creator: Okashi Games
pages.description: React to a circle of opponents in Confront. Tap when the rotating aim reaches a hostile target and keep your shots away from the innocent characters. Read the scene quickly as each standoff leaves little time to decide.

pages.title: Inferno
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Put out fires across more than twenty levels in Inferno. Direct the water where it can stop the spread before the clock runs out. Manage the limited supply carefully enough to save the area without burning yourself.

pages.title: GRAVITY
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: Steer around hazards and strike targets in GRAVITY. Watch how the next obstacle crosses your path and adjust before committing to a move. Keep collecting points as the minimalist course grows more demanding over time.

pages.title: Rotating Disks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control a pair of moving yellow discs in Rotating Disks. Catch yellow balls coming from the middle while keeping both discs away from purple ones. The discs move together, so check the effect on both before changing direction.

pages.title: Azad Cricket
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Score fours and sixes as the last batter in Azad Cricket. Read the incoming ball and time your shot to send it beyond the fielders. Build the runs your country needs as you face the next delivery.

pages.title: Kick The General
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Try different cartoon weapons on a military character in Kick The General. Tap to attack and use the earnings to buy another tool for the next round. See how each option affects the character's ragdoll movement.

pages.title: Couples Yoga
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Drag limbs into the requested pose in Couples Yoga. Compare the figures with the target and adjust one body part at a time to improve the match. Complete the position accurately to work toward three stars.

pages.title: Face Paint Party!
pages.creator: HolaGames
pages.description: Prepare a costume around a painted face in Face Paint Party! Choose a design and complete the makeup before getting ready for the event. Bring the colors and styling details together into a coordinated party look.

pages.title: Paper Animals Pair
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find pairs of folded-animal pictures in Paper Animals Pair. Flip cards to learn their locations, then turn identical images over together. Remember earlier reveals as larger boards make the matching task more difficult.

pages.title: Angry Cat Shot
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Launch a cat through ring-shaped openings in Angry Cat Shot. Set up the jump so the character passes through the middle without touching the rim. Clear the rings in each level to continue to the next arrangement.

pages.title: Ojek Pickup
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Plan motorcycle-taxi routes in Ojek Pickup. Collect passengers and bring them to the destinations they request. Work out the order of stops so the rider can complete each trip around the Indonesian-themed streets.

pages.title: Samurai Fight Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find ten concealed stars per picture in Samurai Fight Hidden. Search six timed scenes and click only when you have identified a star. Wrong selections reduce the remaining time, so balance fast scanning with careful aiming.

pages.title: Hit It
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Shoot into a circle in Hit It while keeping clear of the sticks that appear on its edge. Wait for an open section before tapping. Continue landing safe hits to improve the score without ending the round.

pages.title: Push The Block
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Operate pushers and conveyors in Push The Block. Send each block into its designated hole by choosing the right machine and activation order. Watch how one move changes the positions needed for the next piece.

pages.title: Mini Golf Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Aim for the cup in Mini Golf Adventure. Set the direction and strength before taking a shot, then use the result to judge the next stroke. Complete each course with as few attempts as you can.

pages.title: Farming Simulator Game 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive agricultural machinery in Farming Simulator Game 2020. Use the keyboard controls to work around the fields and carry out the farming tasks. Get used to the vehicles' size and handling as you move between jobs.

pages.title: Wild Rhino Hunter
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Track targets through safari terrain in Wild Rhino Hunter. Move the hunter with the arrow keys and use the mouse to line up shots at the requested animals. Find the rhinos needed for each hunting assignment.

pages.title: Helicopter And Tank Battle Desert Storm Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Join other players in Helicopter And Tank Battle Desert Storm Multiplayer. Fight through a pixel-style desert battlefield with vehicles and weapons around the combat zone. Watch the opposing team as you move into position to attack.

pages.title: Knight Arena.io
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Choose a fighter and weapon in Knight Arena.io. Battle other players around the arena and collect rewards as you strengthen your character. Consider the reach of your weapon before closing the distance to a rival.

pages.title: Bruschetta
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare an Italian appetizer in Bruschetta. Follow the recipe to toast bread and add the garlic, oil and other toppings. Work through the kitchen steps until the small servings are ready for the party.

pages.title: Prison Escape Runner
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Guide a fugitive along an endless course in Prison Escape Runner. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move through the three-dimensional route and avoid the obstacles ahead. Keep the run going to extend the escape.

pages.title: Dot to dot
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Connect points in order in Dot to dot. Drag along the sequence to reveal each complete shape, checking where the next dot belongs before continuing. Finish the current outline to move on to another design.

pages.title: Tractor Express
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Carry farm goods over uneven ground in Tractor Express. Keep the tractor steady while crossing rocks and logs, watching how the trailer follows. Deliver the load without spilling it on the bumpy track.

pages.title: Horizon 2
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Steer through a fast obstacle course in Horizon 2. Use the arrow keys to stay in clear space and collect protection when it becomes available. Keep moving to extend your distance and build a higher score.

pages.title: Carrot Mania
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description: Collect carrots and treasure through one hundred levels in Carrot Mania. Guide the rabbit away from pursuing foxes and scorpions as you gather diamonds and other valuables. Find a safe route to keep the journey moving.

pages.title: Urban Safari Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Explore animal-inspired city clothes in Urban Safari Fashion. Try pieces from the wardrobe and put together a look for a day at school or around town. Coordinate the garments and accessories into one outfit.

pages.title: bala.io
pages.creator: juegocaca.com
pages.description: Fight other players in bala.io and earn points for eliminations. Move through the arena, line up shots and keep clear of return fire. Build your total to move your name higher on the shared rankings.

pages.title: Happy Hamster Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Choose one of eight drawings in Happy Hamster Coloring and paint it with your own palette. Fill in the animal and the details around it, then click the camera to download the finished picture.

pages.title: Ballerina Magazine Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Prepare dancers for a fashion feature in Ballerina Magazine Dress Up. Browse the costumes and accessories to style each ballerina. Compare how the pieces look together before finishing her appearance for the magazine.

pages.title: DEUL
pages.creator: Greenlight Games
pages.description: Outdraw armed opponents in DEUL. Watch for the moment to raise your gun, aim and fire before the other fighter does. Travel through duels in places such as China, London, Russia and Brazil while building your score.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Gardening Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel begin growing plants in Baby Hazel Gardening Time. Choose the clothing and tools she needs, then follow the steps to care for the garden. Learn what the plants require as you work with her.

pages.title: Ball Hook
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hold to send a ball upward in Ball Hook. Watch for obstacles along the tower and release when the path is blocked. Find openings that let the ball continue climbing toward the top.

pages.title: Super Drift 3D
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Customize a car and take it around the track in Super Drift 3D. Work on the turns and build stars from successful races. Spend those stars to unlock another car and try a different way of handling the course.

pages.title: Scary Tiki Mask Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Turn over tropical mask cards in Scary Tiki Mask Memory. Remember each design's position and find its identical partner among the face-down tiles. Complete all four levels while trying to make fewer guesses.

pages.title: Bump.io
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Enter a sixteen-car arena in Bump.io. Strike other vehicles to gain energy and destroy them to grow larger, while avoiding the monsters and the edge. Choose fights carefully as the surviving cars become stronger.

pages.title: Helix Dunk 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Rotate the platform around a basketball in Helix Dunk 3D. Line up openings that let it pass toward the hoops while staying clear of obstacles and enemies. Keep finding another safe path to score.

pages.title: Paint Them All
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Defend a base with paint weapons in Paint Them All. Keep firing into approaching creatures until they fill up and burst. Manage the targets as they enter range and survive each wave to continue.

pages.title: Super Car Stunts
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a car through high stunt tracks in Super Car Stunts. Accelerate for ramps, line up your jumps and bring the vehicle down inside the route. Keep control through the next turn instead of driving off the edge.

pages.title: Spiral Jump 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Guide a jumping ball toward hoops in Spiral Jump 3D. Hold the mouse to control its movement and look for clear openings around the spiral. Avoid the enemies and obstacles as you keep scoring through the course.

pages.title: Happy Glass Puzzles 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Work through three water-themed modes in Happy Glass Puzzles 2. Keep the glass filled or balanced according to the current task and complete the different challenges. Unlock new glass designs and water colors as you progress.

pages.title: SuperHero.io
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Battle through an arena in SuperHero.io. Move with the mouse, attack nearby opponents and use the speed control to reposition. Collect more heroes as you work toward defeating the other fighters.

pages.title: Sports Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six car pictures in Sports Cars Puzzle. Choose among four sizes, from sixteen pieces to one hundred, and fit the image back together. Use the wheels, body panels and background to find the matching edges.

pages.title: Knife Hit Pizza
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Throw blades into a rotating food target in Knife Hit Pizza. Wait for a gap between knives already stuck in the pizza, then send the next one in. Keep the throws clear of existing blades to finish the round.

pages.title: Monster Typer Bomb
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Type the words attached to enemies in Monster Typer Bomb. Complete each spelling to defeat the monster before the bomb explodes. Keep your attention on the next word as the typing challenges continue.

pages.title: East Princess Through the Ages
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style a royal character in East Princess Through the Ages. Explore gowns, hair decorations and sparkling accessories to build her look. Try the different pieces together before she gets ready to receive her visitors.

pages.title: Swan Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild bird pictures in Swan Puzzle Challenge. Pick easy, medium or hard difficulty for each image and match the shapes of the pieces. With no timer, you can work through the scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Worlds Rivers Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together landscape pictures in Worlds Rivers Jigsaw. Choose a river scene and set an easy, medium or hard board, then sort the pieces by water, land and sky. Finish the image without a countdown.

pages.title: Sweden Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Explore a country through pictures in Sweden Jigsaw Challenge. Pick a scene and choose the difficulty before arranging its pieces. Match the colors and details to restore the Swedish image at your own pace.

pages.title: Hunter 3D
pages.creator: GameFlare.com
pages.description: Practice target shooting before heading into the field in Hunter 3D. Earn medals by hitting the center accurately enough, then unlock the wildlife hunting section. Adjust your aim to the new targets once the challenge changes.

pages.title: Coloring Underwater World 4
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Color marine scenes in Coloring Underwater World 4. Choose free mode for any palette you like, or use the hint in challenge mode to remember the example's colors. Match the reference carefully to work toward five stars.

pages.title: School Trends
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two sisters get ready for the new term in School Trends. Try current fashions from their wardrobes and choose an outfit for each student. Coordinate the details before they leave for the first school day.

pages.title: Cooking Battle
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate doughnuts for a contest in Cooking Battle. Choose chocolate, sweets and syrups for the two princesses' desserts. Build a finished design for each plate before comparing their entries in the cooking competition.

pages.title: Flippy Knife Online
pages.creator: MTMEDIA SL
pages.description: Flip a blade through the air in Flippy Knife Online. Choose enough force to cut the fruit or bring the sharp end down into the ground. Watch the landing and adjust the next throw to keep improving the record.

pages.title: Libelle Sudoku
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Complete number grids in Libelle Sudoku. Use the clues already given to fill every row, column and small box without repeating a digit. Compare intersecting lines when a blank square has several possible answers.

pages.title: Freecell Solitaire 2017
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build suit foundations in Freecell Solitaire 2017. Uncover the aces and move cards into the correct ascending order, using the free cells for temporary storage. Plan when to free a cell so later moves remain possible.

pages.title: Paws to Beauty: Birthday
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Groom a pet for a celebration in Paws to Beauty: Birthday. Wash the animal, dry its coat and work through the other care tools. Finish the session by choosing the details of its birthday look.

pages.title: Dragonland
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Defend a dragon's treasure from knights in Dragonland. Aim fireballs through the level and use rebounds to reach opponents behind obstacles. Clear the attackers with well-placed shots to protect the hoard and finish each stage.

pages.title: Strawberry Parfait: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Make a layered fruit dessert in Strawberry Parfait: Sara's Cooking Class. Follow Sara's instructions to prepare the ingredients and combine them in the kitchen. Complete each step to finish the strawberry treat.

pages.title: Princess Zombie
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Dress Elsa, Tiana, Cinderella and Ariel after a supernatural transformation in Princess Zombie. Choose outfits for the infected princesses and coordinate each look with their new appearance. Give the whole group a style for their trip into town.

pages.title: Bridal Dress Designer Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare three entries in Bridal Dress Designer Competition. Help the tailor princess design a wedding dress for each event, choosing the details that make the looks distinct. Finish the collection for presentation in the contest.

pages.title: Elsa Secret Transform
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Search castle rooms for snowflakes in Elsa Secret Transform. Use what you collect to complete puzzles and reveal items for Elsa's new appearance. Ask for a hint when a hidden flake stops you from continuing the transformation.
